extName.message: Video Glow — ambient light for any video

extDescription.message: Soft ambient glow around any video on any site, also in fullscreen. Fills black bars. Shape, blur and size are fully adjustable.

cmdToggle.message: Turn the glow on / off everywhere

cmdSite.message: Turn the glow on / off on this site

s_spread_hint.message: How far the glow extends beyond the video edges

s_feather_hint.message: How smoothly the glow fades toward its outer border: 0 — sharp edge, 100 — soft fade across the whole frame

p_seamless_hint.message: The picture continues beyond the frame edges and the glow is at full strength right at the junction. Also works in fullscreen

p_mode_hint.message: “On top” is visible even over opaque backgrounds and never covers the video itself. “Behind the page” doesn't touch the content but may hide behind block backgrounds.

p_fs_fill_hint.message: Covers the black bars, not just a frame around the video

s_sample_hint.message: Width of the frame taken from the video: smaller — softer and lighter, larger — more detailed

s_fade_hint.message: How long the glow takes to fade out on pause and fade in on play

p_fillbars_hint.message: If the video doesn't fill its block (outside fullscreen)

p_cropbars.message: Ignore black bars inside the video

p_cropbars_hint.message: Movies with baked-in bars (2.39:1) won't produce dark zones in the glow

p_adaptive_hint.message: Automatically lowers the update rate if the computer can't keep up

p_eco_hint.message: Below 30% charge and unplugged, limit updates to 15 fps

s_minwidth_hint.message: Videos narrower than this (previews, banners) are ignored

st_ok.message: The glow is working on this page

st_paused.message: Video is paused — the glow is off

st_small.message: The video is smaller than the minimum width

st_pageoff.message: Glow on the page is turned off

st_fsoff.message: Glow in fullscreen is turned off

st_offscreen.message: The video is not visible on screen

st_hidden.message: The video is hidden by the page

st_novideo.message: The video has not loaded yet

st_none.message: No video found on this page

st_unreadable.message: The browser doesn't allow reading frames of this video (other domain / protection). The glow works, but black-bar detection is unavailable.

o_sites_hint.message: The glow never appears on these sites.

o_reset_confirm.message: Reset all settings to defaults? The list of disabled sites will be cleared too.

o_shortcuts_text.message: Turn on / off everywhere: Alt+Shift+B. Settings panel over the page and fullscreen video: Alt+Shift+G (or the gear button on the video). “Turn on / off on this site” has no default key — assign one in the browser's shortcut settings.

o_privacy_text.message: Video Glow does not collect or send any data. Settings are stored locally in your browser.

o_limits_text.message: Videos protected by DRM (Netflix, Disney+ and similar) can't be read by the browser, so there is no glow for them. For videos from another domain without CORS, black-bar detection and the “video itself in fullscreen” mode are unavailable.

w_sub.message: Ambient glow for any video on any site.

w_step1.message: Open any video and press play — the glow appears smoothly around it.

w_step2.message: Click the extension icon to change size, blur, shape and presets.

w_step3.message: Press Alt+Shift+B to turn the glow on or off.

w_step4.message: In fullscreen the glow fills the black bars of your screen.

w_note.message: No glow? Open the popup — it tells you why (paused, too small, protected video…).

st_useroff.message: Glow turned off with the button on the video

p_scope_hint.message: Off: changes apply to all sites. On: only to this site.

p_fs_same_hint.message: Off: fullscreen gets its own blur, brightness and pause settings.

p_dim.message: Dim the page around the player

p_dim_hint.message: Cinema mode: everything except the video gets darker.

p_hover_hint.message: A small button appears on the video when you move the mouse over it.

o_custom_hint.message: Enable "Own settings for this site" in the popup to add a site here.

w_perm_title.message: One more step: allow access to sites

w_perm_text.message: To draw the glow next to videos, Video Glow needs permission to run on the sites you watch videos on. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere. Without this permission the extension does nothing.

w_perm_done.message: Done — the glow is now active. Reload tabs that were open before.

p_perm_need.message: The glow is not active yet: access to sites has not been allowed.

p_bars_hint.message: Forced mode finds gray or noisy bars on any side, even one-sided ones. Very dark scenes may be mistaken for bars.

p_barshide_hint.message: Zooms the video so the picture fills the player. The edges are cropped.

s_barsfill_hint.message: 0 — only fit the picture, 100 — fill the player completely.

p_guard_hint.message: Dims the video and the glow when the picture flickers or strobes (3+ flashes per second). Not a medical device.

s_calm_hint.message: Smooths colour changes over time, fewer sudden jumps.

p_pulse_hint.message: The glow beats with the audio. Sound is analysed on your device and never recorded. Avoid if you are sensitive to flashing.

s_fx_sharp_hint.message: Sharpness, warmth and shadows use an SVG filter and can be heavy on 4K video.

p_night_hint.message: In the chosen hours the video turns warmer and darker and the glow softer. Same for all sites.

st_guard.message: Flash protection is active right now.

st_pulse_nodata.message: Sound pulse: this video gives no audio data.

o_pro_none.message: Pro is not active. Enter a license key to unlock all Pro features.

o_pro_trial.message: Trial period: $N$ day(s) left. Pro features work until it ends.

o_pro_features.message: Pro includes: forced black bar detection and removal, flash protection and calm glow, sound pulse, video filters, night comfort.

o_key_ph.message: Paste your license key (starts with VG1.)

o_key_format.message: That doesn't look like a license key

o_pro_offline.message: The key is verified on this device and no network requests are made. Keep it somewhere safe; backups do not include it.

p_fs_shape_own_hint.message: Separate shape, size and softness of the frame in fullscreen.

p_fs_shape_note.message: The frame is used when “Fill the whole screen” is off; with it on, the glow fills the screen.

panel_unpin.message: Unpin: hide after 10 s without the cursor

cmdPanel.message: Show / hide the settings panel over the page

o_presets_hint.message: A preset sets the whole look in one click: the glow, the page dimming and the video filters. Change the built-in ones or make your own — you can copy the current settings into any preset.

o_theme_hint.message: Theme for the menu, the panel and these pages. The glow itself stays the same.

p_style_hint.message: “LEDs” looks like a light strip behind a TV: separate spots of light, each in its own colour.

p_room_hint.message: The whole page is softly tinted with the video’s colours. Works best with the site’s dark theme.

hue_hint.message: Room lamps follow the colours of the video. Works through the Hue Bridge in your home network; nothing leaves your network.

hue_not_found.message: No bridge found. Enter its address (Hue app → Settings → Bridges).

hue_press.message: Press the round button on the bridge ($1 s left)…

hue_timeout.message: The button wasn't pressed. Try again.

hue_no_lights.message: The bridge has no colour lamps.

hue_many.message: Many lamps make updates slower (the bridge takes about 10 commands per second).

hue_err_net.message: The bridge isn't responding. Check that it's on and in the same network.

hue_err_auth.message: The bridge no longer accepts this connection. Press Connect again.

hue_err_busy.message: Search is busy, try in 15 minutes or enter the address.

hue_err_notbridge.message: There's no Hue Bridge at this address.

p_scene_hint.message: A soft flash of light on sharp scene changes and explosions, a slow “breath” in dark scenes. Flash protection always wins.

lt_title.message: Room lights: WLED and Home Assistant

lt_hint.message: A WLED LED strip and any lights in Home Assistant follow the video colours. Everything stays on your home network, nothing goes to the internet.

lt_delay_hint.message: If the lights change before the picture (for example, your TV adds lag), move it right. 0 means no delay.

lt_err_net.message: The device does not respond. Check that it is on and on the same network.

wl_err_notwled.message: There is no WLED at this address.

wl_layout_single.message: One colour for the whole strip

wl_restore.message: Restore the strip after the video

wl_help.message: “Around the screen”: the strip runs clockwise from the bottom-left corner (as you face the screen). If the colours are shifted, adjust “Start offset” or turn on “Counter-clockwise”.

ha_on.message: Send the colour to Home Assistant

ha_sent.message: Orange sent. If the light did not change, check the automation below.

ha_err_url.message: Enter the webhook address as http://host:8123/api/webhook/id.

ha_err_http.message: Home Assistant returned an error. Check that the automation with this webhook is saved.

ha_help.message: In Home Assistant: Settings → Automations → Create → Edit in YAML. Paste the text below, replace light.tv with your lights and save. Then enter the webhook address above and press “Test”. start snapshots the scene, play sends the colour, stop restores the lights.

p_auto_hint.message: Auto preset: recognises the kind of video (film, anime, games, sport) and adjusts the glow by itself

auto_wait.message: Auto preset: looking at the video…

auto_none.message: Auto preset: nothing specific, your own settings

q_glowwin.message: Glow window: a separate window that glows with the video colour (move it to a second monitor)

pip_hint.message: Move this window to a second monitor or next to the screen

w_s1_text.message: A soft glow appears around the player and follows the colours of the scene. It works on any site, nothing to set up.

w_s2_text.message: “Auto” recognises films, anime, games and sport and adjusts the glow by itself. You can change it any time in the extension window.

w_s3_text.message: Pin the Video Glow icon on the toolbar (the puzzle icon → pin). The window shows why there is no glow, if something is wrong.

w_s3_key.message: turns the glow on and off

w_import_hint.message: Moving from another computer? Load your backup file and all your settings come back.

p_lite_hint.message: For computers without graphics acceleration (often Linux + Firefox): the glow updates less often and skips heavy effects. Auto turns it on by itself when needed.

p_zoompan_hint.message: Alt + wheel to zoom, Alt + drag to move, Alt + double-click to reset
